prerequisites.title: Free Xero account
prerequisites.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account first. The recommended development route is the demo company, which costs nothing.

prerequisites.title: Your own Xero OAuth app
prerequisites.detail: Xero does not support API keys. Register an app to get a client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Customer with purchased Custom Connections
prerequisites.detail: The customer must buy a subscription with enough custom connections. You can develop against the free demo company first.

steps.title: Create Xero account and demo company
steps.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account and use the demo company for development.
steps.done_when: You can sign in and see the demo company.

steps.title: Register OAuth app on developer.xero.com
steps.detail: Register your app to get a client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into your Xero app. Then create the Xero auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection to the demo company succeeds.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Draft answers on authentication, encryption, audit logging and personnel security from your architecture notes.
steps.done_when: A complete draft is ready for your review.

steps.title: Review and submit security assessment
steps.detail: Check the answers are true, then submit them to Xero. Expect about 5 working days of work.

steps.title: Xero reviews the assessment
steps.detail: Xero's security team takes 5-10 working days and may ask follow-up questions.
steps.done_when: Xero reports pass or sends a remediation report.

steps.title: Remediate findings if not passed
steps.detail: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement changes within 60 days. Xero then re-reviews.
steps.done_when: Xero confirms the standards are met.

steps.title: Customer purchases Custom Connections
steps.detail: The customer buys Custom Connections for their organisation. If it is your own organisation, you are that user.
inputs: Customer's Xero organisation in AU, NZ, UK or US
steps.done_when: Custom Connections show on the customer's subscription.

steps.title: Create Custom Connection app and request access
steps.detail: Create the app on developer.xero.com, select scopes, then request authorisation from the Xero user.
steps.done_when: The customer grants authorisation and the connection is activated.

steps.title: Test token request with client credentials
steps.detail: Request an access token with the client ID and secret, then call the Xero API.
steps.done_when: A test API call returns data.

traps.title: Assessment repeats every year
traps.detail: The security assessment must be passed annually, so plan for recurring work.

traps.title: Extra review at 1000 connections
traps.detail: At 1000 or more connections, an advanced security assessment applies.

traps.title: Some Xero APIs always trigger assessment
traps.detail: All consumers of the Practice Manager, HQ and Tax APIs are affected regardless of connection count. Xero can also require it from others.

traps.title: No listing without passing
traps.detail: Apps are not certified or listed in the Xero app marketplace without passing the assessments.

traps.title: Custom Connection covers one organisation
traps.detail: Each Custom Connection reaches a single Xero organisation, and the customer pays a monthly fee for it. It does not suit a multi-customer agent product.

traps.title: Custom Connections may not work with Composio
traps.detail: Custom Connections use the client credentials grant instead of the standard OAuth flow. Composio support for this was not confirmed.

blockers.symptom: Xero returns a remediation report after the assessment
blockers.what_it_means: The app did not meet the standards yet.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement changes within 60 days. Xero then re-reviews.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan and list the code or config changes needed.

blockers.symptom: Customer organisation is outside AU, NZ, UK or US
blockers.what_it_means: Custom Connections are not available for that organisation.
blockers.what_to_do: Use the standard OAuth 2.0 app path instead.

open_questions: Is a security assessment needed before the first outside customers can connect when under 1000 connections? Ask Xero developer support or check the app partner programme terms.
Does Xero cap connections for an uncertified app? The dossier found no documented limit; confirm with Xero developer support.
Does Xero verify redirect-URI domains? Not found; test redirect setup in the developer portal.
Does Composio support Xero Custom Connections (client credentials)? Check with Composio support.
Does Xero have a partner acceptance step for app partners? Not found; check Xero's partnership pages or ask Xero.
How long does the process take in practice? No real-world reports were found; ask developers who were certified.
Not found: scope or permission tiers. Checked xero.com, xero.com.
